data.name: Fatiq
data.gender_notes: Fatiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fatara' which means 'to split' or 'to conquer'. The name Fatiq is given to a boy symbolizing victory, triumph, and conquest in various aspects of life. The name is mentioned in the Quran, where Prophet Yunus (Jonah) is referred to as 'Fatiq al-Bahir' meaning 'the Conquering Prophet'. The name Fatiq carries the meaning “The Conqueror, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatiq usually hope their child will grow to embody the conqueror, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of triumph over challenges and a reminder of the power of faith and determination.
data.etymology: Fatiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Conqueror, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatiq total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
